top news.title: SpaceX agrees to acquire Cursor in a merger valuing the AI coding startup at $60B, set to close in Q3 2026, or pay a $4B to $10B termination fee

tweets.author: @spacex
tweets.text: SpaceX has exercised the option to acquire @cursor_ai in an all-stock transaction with the goal of building the world's most useful AI models. For the past few months, SpaceXAI has been jointly training a model with Cursor, which will be released in Cursor and Grok Build soon.

tweets.author: @apostructura
tweets.text: It's an all stock deal which means that SpaceX is giving Cursor investors “only” 2.4% equity in SpaceX. Being worth $2.5T has its perks

tweets.author: @austen
tweets.text: Cursor or SpaceX alone can't really play in the enterprise coding game. Cursor + SpaceX/xAi? Now it's a ball game. Have a lot of catching up to do as models go, but they're in the race.

top news.title: Snap unveils $2,195 Specs, its first AR glasses that are “fully standalone” and have a 51-degree field of view, expected “this fall” in the US, UK, and France

tweets.author: @autismcapital
tweets.text: The new Snapchat Specs are still absurd and goofy but shoutout Snapchat for still going for it. All of these are iterative steps to the AR future. When the tech finally gets there, people are going to be rocked. [image]

tweets.author: @markgurman
tweets.text: Spiegel called the Specs both “very, very” wearable and highly capable, which he said gives Snap an opportunity “in a market that's focused either on very large and clunky headsets that are super capable or very lightweight glasses that don't really do much.”

tweets.author: @mweinbach
tweets.text: Specs have dual Snapdragon processors! Wonder if this will become more common on glasses, dual chip. Makes a ton of sense. [image]

sub_items.title: A look at Specs, which have a battery life of up to four hours per charge, and an interview with Snap CEO Evan Spiegel about the AR glasses

top news.title: Google launches Android 17 and Wear OS 7, first on Pixel devices, with support for the latest AI models, a bubble bar UI, and live updates on Wear OS

tweets.author: @pixeluibygoogle
tweets.text: Android 17 introduces great new features and APIs for developers. Features & APIs: Enhances profiling/debugging, adds efficient alarms, improves privacy with contact picker & ECH, strengthens security with Advanced Protection & PQC signing, and optimizes satellite connectivity.

tweets.author: @rosterloh
tweets.text: Android 17 is officially rolling out today, bringing some incredible upgrades to your daily experience.  🚀 We're delivering faster multitasking with Bubbles 🫧 (helpful for keeping track of @USMNT while getting things done), major new creative capabilities with native tools like Screen Reactions 🎬, and critical security enhancements to give you peace of mind 🔐

tweets.author: @mishaalrahman
tweets.text: 🫧 Android 17 brings a new way to multitask with Bubbles! You can now open any app in a floating bubble for next-level multitasking! And for foldable users, a new bubble bar on the taskbar anchors these apps to make them more organized. [image]
